minimality_boundary.proof: Let S=F_89[q_0,...,q_36] and m=(q_0,...,q_36). The 56 monic pure-K cubic rules reduce all K-degree at least three to B={1,K,Sym2 K}, so 28 states generate. Every residual or transition-hull relation is homogeneous of total degree at least three, while every B state has degree at most two; hence every coefficient of every such relation lies in m. At q=0 the rules become all pure K^3=0 and no relation among B remains, so (R/J_N) tensor_S S/m has dimension 1+6+21=28. Any S-generating carrier must therefore have at least 28 elements. This state-count proof does not require a degree-5 computation.
